task_description: Migrate the seven remaining hand-rolled agent-spec reads (plain `json.loads(path.read_text())` over the user-writable agents dir) onto agent_discovery._read_agent_spec, the one hardened reader (size cap, sensitive-symlink refusal, UTF-8/AppleDouble screening, non-object-JSON rejection). Introduce a single shared name->model helper (agent_model_map) to collapse the three divergent name->model scan spellings (_resolve_agent_model, _build_kiro_model_map, list_agents) at the root. Preserve each caller's existing failure semantics: a refused spec degrades exactly like an absent one, with no new fatal paths. Follow-up to PR #5423 (First Principles review CONCERNS, accepted-and-deferred).
